item.description: - Dev server banners now show only servers started by that thread, from its own terminal or agent. Other apps, the agent harnesses themselves, servers from sibling threads and processes in broad folders such as your home folder no longer appear, and Stop never targets a harness process. - On iPhone Duo, Send and the microphone respond again when folded. The composer now stays inside its bar instead of running under the toolbar rail, which also keeps it clear of the Thread Actions button when the keyboard is up. - On Mac, the sidebar's titlebar controls stay locked to the sidebar edge while it opens, closes or is resized, without lag or stutter, and the new-thread capsule's glass morph runs smoothly (honoring Reduce Motion). - The Inspector's titlebar buttons no longer jump or drift when the Inspector opens, closes or is resized, its tabs stay attached to its edge, and switching Inspector tabs is faster.

- **Edit from here & deeper search:** Rewind any sent message in place (choosing to revert or keep files in isolated worktrees) and edit your prompt before resending. Search across full thread history (`⌘F`), including older unloaded turns, match branches, pull requests, and message text in sidebar search, and cite any assistant excerpt directly into the composer as a `@quote` chip. - **Sidebar triage & Command Palette:** Active runs that don’t need your input now fold into a collapsible **Working** shelf on Mac and iPhone so Active stays focused on what needs attention. Settle, snooze, unpin, and archive show a 5-second Undo toast (`⌘Z` on Mac), with multi-select bulk triage, custom snooze times, editable presets, and opt-in idle auto-settle with a per-thread *Never Auto-Settle* toggle. Press `⌘K` on Mac for the new Command Palette and `⌘1–⌘9` to jump straight to inbox threads. - **Composer upgrades & multi-model fan-out:** Edit queued prompts in place, promote any queued prompt with *Send Now*, reorder the queue, and pick your default Queue vs. Steer follow-up mode. Large pastes (≥ 32 KiB) attach automatically as files, `↑`/`↓` recalls earlier prompts, `⌘S` stashes drafts for later, `⌘⌥⏎` sends in the background and opens a fresh draft, and *Compare Models…* launches parallel isolated worktree threads across multiple models. - **Inspector tabs, Git review & automatic worktree cleanup:** The Mac Inspector now opens files, diffs, PRs, subagents, and browser pages as multi-instance tabs with *Close Others* and `⇧⌘T` reopen, plus scoped per-turn and per-tool diffs. Pull request review adds per-file *Viewed* tracking, Auto-Merge, Revert PR, optional AI credit stripping, clean default-branch auto-pull, and branch naming prefixes. Settings → Worktrees adds opt-in safe automatic worktree cleanup with an audit log. - **Schedules, CLI, deep links & Mac polish:** View, create, pause, run now, and delete recurring schedules and `/heartbeat` prompts from Settings → **Schedules** on Mac and iPhone. Install the `controller` CLI from Settings → General (`controller .`, `controller new`, `controller run --wait`) or open prefilled drafts via `controller://new?...` deep links. Mac also adds Launch at Login, a Dock attention badge, distinct completion and needs-input sound cues, and smarter onboarding discovery for harnesses, local Git repos, and past Claude/Codex sessions. - **iPhone widgets, Share Extension, multi-Mac & UI polish:** iPhone and iPad add Home and Lock Screen widgets for active agents and subscription usage, an iOS Share Extension for sending links, text, images, and files straight into Controller, *Auto (Least Busy Mac)* selection with live host headroom, loopback-safe remote dev server preview forwarding, refined iPhone Duo composer/model picker/task plan chip animations, and improved Antigravity 1.5.16 native edit diffs.

- You can now remove any non-built-in harness account even when it has existing conversations, native bindings, or project defaults. Idle conversations keep their history, switch to your fallback account, and hand off prior context automatically on the next turn; removal is only blocked while active work or pending requests are running on that account. - Fixed an error where Muse Code could show `Swift.CancellationError` after background discovery refreshed unchanged account settings while it was connecting. - Antigravity updates to Google's official Antigravity CLI 1.5.16 runtime with direct mid-turn steering (keeping running subagents and background tasks alive), native system prompt append, tool-free sessions, ACP form elicitation, and isolated file token storage. - Managed Pi accounts now use Pi 1.6.0, Cursor accounts now use Cursor SDK 1.5.0 (Settings offers the new downloads), Factory Droid SDK accounts now use `@factory/droid-sdk` 0.11.0, and Muse Code adds Muse 1.4.24 session-rename capability negotiation and described reasoning effort variants.
